name: Efficus: Kono Omoi o Kimi ni...
original_name: エフィカス この想いを君に…
source: The protagonist gets suddenly transferred to a former all-girls school. Tired of hanging out with boys, he decides to get closer to the girls...
translation: The protagonist gets suddenly transferred to a former all-girls school. Tired of hanging out with boys, he decides to get closer to the girls...
